LanguageData.VGE_Exoworm.label: exoworm
LanguageData.VGE_Exoworm.description: A large, genetically-engineered worm-like insectoid, adapted to survive in the vacuum of space. Once the worker caste of an artificial ecosystem designed to fight mechanoid invasions, it is now often encountered without its deadlier insectoid cousins. Still, its size and rapidly regenerating body makes it a durable and dangerous foe in combat. A eusocial creature, it cannot reproduce individually.
